title: The Pier Box Answers In MY Handwriting 🗝️
description:
The lock-box on our pier answers one question per person, ever, in your own handwriting by morning.

I asked whether to tell my best friend I'm moving across the country. It answered me two mornings in a row, and the two cards disagree.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Which card did the box really write, 1 or 2? Comment the number and your clue.
